tools.name: compare
tools.description:
Compare two Danish politicians/persons, two political parties, or one person against one party
            majority vote. Pass free-text names in left and right; when a name is ambiguous, retry with a specific
            input like person:123 or party:6 from the returned candidates. Leave result_filter as all for overall
            agreement; use only_agreement/only_disagreement only to inspect matching result rows. Comparable votes
            only include For, Imod, and Hverken for eller imod; Fravær/absence and undetermined party majority votes
            are excluded.

left.description: Left side person or party name. Use person:123 or party:123 to select a specific ID when a name is ambiguous.

right.description: Right side person or party name. Use person:123 or party:123 to select a specific ID when a name is ambiguous.

result_filter.description: Filter returned result rows. Use all for overall comparison questions. Use only_agreement/only_disagreement only to inspect matching result rows. This does not calculate overall agreement; summary remains the overall comparison after non-result-filter constraints.

query.description: Free-text query for Danish case title.

from_date.description: Earliest afstemning date, formatted as YYYY-MM-DD.

to_date.description: Latest afstemning date, formatted as YYYY-MM-DD.

vote_type_id.description:
Vote type ID. For person/person and person/party comparisons this filters person votes; for
                        party/party comparisons this filters party majority votes.

vote_cast_type_id.description: Afstemning type ID from the vote event type vocabulary resource.

case_type_id.description: Related case type ID from the case type vocabulary resource.

category_id.description:
Advanced refinement filter. Use only when the user explicitly asks
        for this category or to narrow an already-inspected result set; categories are difficult to distinguish and
        should usually be omitted for initial searches.

include_change_proposals.description: Include amendment/change proposal afstemninger. Defaults to false because change proposal vote casts do not describe what they changed.

tools.name: fetch
tools.description:
Universal Deep Research-compatible fetch tool. Takes an id returned by search and returns a readable
            JSON document with id, title, text, url, and metadata.

id.description: Result ID returned by the search tool, for example case:123, vote_cast:456, person:789, or party:2.

tools.name: get_case
tools.description:
Get compact details for one Danish parliamentary case, including paginated associated document
            metadata and file IDs for optional extracted document text retrieval.

case_id.description: Case ID from search_cases, search_vote_casts, or vote search related_case.id.

document_offset.description: Offset into the associated document metadata list. Use with document_limit to page through large case document lists.

document_limit.description: Maximum number of associated document metadata records to return. Use 0 to omit document items while keeping document counts.

tools.name: get_case_debate
tools.description: Read a case's first-reading debate track, including speech text and source links. Filter by person or party and page through entries. Chairing remarks are excluded by default.

person_id.description: Only speeches by this resolved person ID.

party_id.description: Only speeches by this party ID, using party membership on the meeting date when needed.

include_chair.description: Include chairing speeches, which are omitted by default.

offset.description: Offset into the filtered debate entries.

limit.description: Maximum number of debate entries to return.

tools.name: get_document_text
tools.description:
Return a bounded slice of extracted text for a document file. Supports head, tail, and range
            pagination. Files with stored HTML of 2 MB or more return only an official source PDF reference.

mode.description: Text slice mode. Use head for the beginning, tail for the end, or range with offset for pagination.

offset.description: Character offset used only when mode is range. Use next_offset from a prior response to continue reading.

limit.description: Maximum number of extracted-text characters to return.

tools.name: get_election
tools.description:
Inspect one public Danish parliamentary or municipal election by ID or slug. Returns election
            metadata, public result status, national turnout, vote totals and party vote shares, update timestamps,
            calculated but not officially verified parliamentary mandate counts, and the previous comparable election
            when available. Use list_elections to discover valid IDs and slugs, and the election-parties vocabulary
            resource to interpret list letters and abbreviations.

election_slug.description: Election slug from list_elections, for example fv-2022 or kv-2025.

tools.name: get_election_candidates
tools.description: Inspect candidate names, votes, and vote shares for one FV or KV election and geographic scope. Year is required. Party and candidate text filters can be combined. Candidate names accept IDs, slugs, exact names, or partial names. With one uniquely resolved candidate, breakdown_by can rank their regions, municipalities, or polling areas. Historical geographic candidate rows prove recorded results in the scope, not a complete authoritative ballot roster.

election_type.description: FV for Folketingsvalg or KV for Kommunalvalg.

region.description: Region code or name, for example Region Midtjylland.

constituency.description: Folketingsvalg constituency (Danish: storkreds) code or name.

nomination_district.description: Folketingsvalg nomination district (Danish: opstillingskreds) code or name.

municipality.description: Municipality code, slug, or name, for example Horsens.

polling_area.description: Polling area (Danish: afstemningsområde) DAGI code or name.

party.description: Optional party name, abbreviation, list letter, or election list ID.

candidate.description: Optional candidate ID, slug, exact name, or partial name.

breakdown_by.description: With one uniquely resolved candidate, break their result down geographically.

tools.name: get_election_history
tools.description: Track turnout, vote totals, party or candidate performance, bloc shares, bloc lead, or calculated FV mandates across elections. from_year and to_year are optional and inclusive; omitted bounds mean all available history. Geography filters select the same named/code scope in each election. breakdown_by election returns a time series; region, constituency, or municipality ranks that dimension across the period using weighted vote totals rather than averaging percentages. Calculated mandates are not officially verified.

election_type.description: FV for Folketingsvalg or KV for Kommunalvalg.

region.description: Region code or name, for example Region Midtjylland.

constituency.description: Folketingsvalg constituency (Danish: storkreds) code or name.

nomination_district.description: Folketingsvalg nomination district (Danish: opstillingskreds) code or name.

municipality.description: Municipality code, slug, or name, for example Horsens.

polling_area.description: Polling area (Danish: afstemningsområde) DAGI code or name.

party.description: Required for party metrics; accepts name, abbreviation, letter, or list ID.

candidate.description: Required for candidate metrics; accepts candidate ID, slug, or name.

breakdown_by.description: Group by election, or rank one geographic dimension across the period.

tools.name: get_election_votes
tools.description: Inspect vote totals, turnout, party/list vote shares, bloc winner and lead for one FV or KV election. Year is required. With no geography it returns national data; region, constituency, nomination district, municipality, and polling area arguments drill into applicable scopes. Optional party filtering accepts names, abbreviations, list letters, and list IDs. National FV seats are calculated by Politikdata and explicitly not officially verified mandate counts.

year.description: Election year. Returns election_not_found when no matching election exists.

election_type.description: FV for Folketingsvalg or KV for Kommunalvalg.

region.description: Region code or name, for example Region Midtjylland.

constituency.description: Folketingsvalg constituency (Danish: storkreds) code or name.

nomination_district.description: Folketingsvalg nomination district (Danish: opstillingskreds) code or name.

municipality.description: Municipality code, slug, or name, for example Horsens.

polling_area.description: Polling area (Danish: afstemningsområde) DAGI code or name.

party.description: Optional party name, abbreviation, list letter, or election list ID.

tools.name: get_legal_document
tools.description: Read legislation metadata, related resource IDs with reference_lookup tool instructions, version history and a bounded text slice. Continue with text_offset=next_offset.

tools.name: get_party
tools.description:
Get compact details for one Danish political party, including the manually registered party leader,
            profile statistics, national FV/KV vote-share history, latest parliamentary election result, validity
            dates, and public URLs. Any parliamentary mandate count marked calculated is not officially verified. Use
            compare with party:ID when comparing this party against a person or another party.

party_id.description: Party ID from the parties vocabulary resource or party vote search results.

tools.name: get_person
tools.description:
Get compact details for one Danish politician/person, including public biography summary, roles,
            party memberships, parliamentary vote statistics, election candidacies, and personal election votes. Use
            compare with person:ID when comparing this person against another person or a party majority vote.

person_id.description: Person ID from search_persons, resolve_person, or a person-specific vote result.

tools.name: get_question
tools.description: Read a question with inline answers, actors, original files and provenance. Page answers with answer_offset; read full text with text_offset. Use answer_id to pin any related answer. Answers have no independent detail resource.

query.description: Repeat the search query to include matching answers outside the ordinary answer window.

tools.name: get_question_history
tools.description: Read the non-searchable parliamentary timeline for a question, including source provenance, corrections and observation dates. Page with offset and limit.

tools.name: get_verdict
tools.description: Read a verdict with original publication links, legal citation evidence, related resource IDs, reference_lookup tool instructions, outcomes and bounded text. Named-law mentions are textual findings, not confirmed historical law versions.

tools.name: get_vote_cast
tools.description: Get compact details for one Danish parliamentary afstemning/vote cast, related legislation and verdict IDs with reference_lookup tool instructions, and paginated party vote breakdown. Use get_vote_cast_votes for the full roll-call list of individual politician votes.

vote_cast_id.description: Vote cast / afstemning ID from search_vote_casts or vote search results.

party_vote_offset.description: Offset into the party vote breakdown list.

party_vote_limit.description: Maximum number of party vote breakdown rows to return. Use 0 to omit party vote items while keeping counts.

tools.name: get_vote_cast_votes
tools.description:
Get the full voting breakdown for one Danish parliamentary afstemning/vote cast, including both
            party-level votes and individual politician roll-call votes.

vote_cast_id.description: Vote cast / afstemning ID from search_vote_casts or vote search results.

tools.name: list_elections
tools.description:
List public Danish parliamentary and municipal elections that have result data or are
            enabled for live coverage. Returns IDs and slugs for get_election, plus current default/live markers and
            public URLs.

tools.name: resolve_person
tools.description:
Resolve politicians by name only. Use this when an MCP client needs person IDs before calling
            person-specific tools.

name.description: Full or partial name of a politician. Searches only person name fields.

current_only.description: Limit to politicians active in the current period.

tools.name: search
tools.description: Universal Deep Research-compatible search across Politikdata.dk questions and answers, cases, vote casts, people, parties, legislation and verdicts. Use fetch with a returned id to retrieve a readable citation source.

tools.name: search_cases
tools.description:
Search Danish parliamentary cases/documents by text, date range, type, category, and topic. Category
            filters should usually be omitted for initial searches and used only for refinement.

query.description: Free-text query for case title, resume, explanation, or case number.

from_date.description: Earliest update date, formatted as YYYY-MM-DD.

to_date.description: Latest update date, formatted as YYYY-MM-DD.

case_type_id.description: Case type ID from the case type vocabulary resource.

category_id.description:
Advanced refinement filter. Use only when the user explicitly asks
        for this category or to narrow an already-inspected result set; categories are difficult to distinguish and
        should usually be omitted for initial searches.

keyword_text.description: Natural-language topic text. Prefer this when exact keyword IDs are ambiguous.

tools.name: search_keywords
tools.description:
Search parliamentary topic keywords by text. Results are ordered by associated document count so
            frequently used keywords are suggested first.

query.description: Keyword text or partial topic text to search for.

tools.name: search_legal_documents
tools.description: Search legislation from Retsinformation, including legal text. Use get_legal_document for metadata and paged text. Historical versions can be included explicitly.

tools.name: search_party_votes
tools.description:
Search how a Danish political party voted in Folketinget afstemninger/stemmer. Use party IDs from the
            parties vocabulary resource. Category filters should usually be omitted for initial searches and used
            only for refinement.

party_id.description: Party ID from the parties vocabulary resource.

query.description: Free-text query for Danish case title.

from_date.description: Earliest afstemning date, formatted as YYYY-MM-DD.

to_date.description: Latest afstemning date, formatted as YYYY-MM-DD.

vote_type_id.description: Party vote type ID from the vote types vocabulary resource.

vote_cast_type_id.description: Afstemning type ID from the vote event type vocabulary resource.

case_type_id.description: Related case type ID from the case type vocabulary resource.

category_id.description:
Advanced refinement filter. Use only when the user explicitly asks
        for this category or to narrow an already-inspected result set; categories are difficult to distinguish and
        should usually be omitted for initial searches.

include_change_proposals.description: Include amendment/change proposal afstemninger. Defaults to false because change proposal vote casts do not describe what they changed.

tools.name: search_person_votes
tools.description:
Search how a Danish politician/person voted in Folketinget afstemninger/stemmer. Use resolve_person
            first when only a name is known. Category filters should usually be omitted for initial searches and used
            only for refinement.

person_id.description: Person ID. Use resolve_person first when only a name is known.

query.description: Free-text query for Danish case title.

from_date.description: Earliest afstemning date, formatted as YYYY-MM-DD.

to_date.description: Latest afstemning date, formatted as YYYY-MM-DD.

vote_type_id.description: Person vote type ID from the vote types vocabulary resource.

vote_cast_type_id.description: Afstemning type ID from the vote event type vocabulary resource.

case_type_id.description: Related case type ID from the case type vocabulary resource.

category_id.description:
Advanced refinement filter. Use only when the user explicitly asks
        for this category or to narrow an already-inspected result set; categories are difficult to distinguish and
        should usually be omitted for initial searches.

include_change_proposals.description: Include amendment/change proposal afstemninger. Defaults to false because change proposal vote casts do not describe what they changed.

tools.name: search_persons
tools.description: Resolve or search politicians by name, optionally limited by parliamentary period.

query.description: Name or partial name of a politician.

current_only.description: Limit to politicians active in the current period.

sort_by.description: Optional explicit sort field. Omit to keep relevance-first ordering for name searches.

sort_direction.description: Sort direction for explicit sort_by. Defaults to asc.

tools.name: search_questions
tools.description: Search all Danish parliamentary questions including text in their answers. Results and facets count distinct questions; answers appear inline. Use get_question to read all answers.

query.description: Words in a question or any of its answers.

tools.name: search_verdicts
tools.description: Search published judgments and decisions, optionally filtered by source. Set include_other_publications for summaries, opinions, settlements and procedural records. Use get_verdict for citation findings, outcomes and paged text.

include_other_publications.description: Include summaries, opinions, settlements, records and procedural publications.

tools.name: search_vote_casts
tools.description:
Search Danish parliamentary afstemninger/stemmer, meaning aggregate vote results for a case step.
            This does not search individual person or party votes. Category filters should usually be omitted for
            initial searches and used only for refinement.

query.description: Free-text query for Danish case title or case number.

from_date.description: Earliest meeting date, formatted as YYYY-MM-DD.

to_date.description: Latest meeting date, formatted as YYYY-MM-DD.

vote_cast_type_id.description: Afstemning type ID from the vote cast/event type vocabulary resource.

case_type_id.description: Related case type ID from the case type vocabulary resource.

category_id.description:
Advanced refinement filter. Use only when the user explicitly asks
        for this category or to narrow an already-inspected result set; categories are difficult to distinguish and
        should usually be omitted for initial searches.

keyword_text.description: Natural-language topic text. Prefer this when exact keyword IDs are ambiguous.

include_change_proposals.description: Include amendment/change proposal afstemninger. Defaults to false.
